verses.pali: “Saddhā, bhikkhave, bhikkhunī evaṁ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya:
‘tādisī homi yādisī khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā cā’ti.
verses.english: ‘May I be like the nuns Khemā and Uppalavaṇṇā!’

verses.pali: Esā, bhikkhave, tulā etaṁ pamāṇaṁ mama sāvikānaṁ bhikkhunīnaṁ yadidaṁ khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā cā”ti.
verses.english: These are a standard and a measure for my nun disciples, that is, the nuns Khemā and Uppalavaṇṇā.”
